artworks.title: Peter the Great
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a head and shoulders profile portrait of a man within an oval frame. The subject is positioned in a side view facing to the left. He has a prominent nose, curly shoulder-length hair styled in waves. The man wears a high-collared garment with intricate details and a brooch. A rectangular border surrounds the oval frame with the name "PIERRE Ier." The background is plain with a textured area around the frame.

artworks.title: Simon-Nicolas-Henri Linguet
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a central medallion portrait of a man with white, somewhat curly hair, a prominent aquiline nose, and a formal attire. Surrounding the portrait, there is a scene with an older, bearded winged figure holding a scythe above the medallion and small winged cherubs engaged with scrolls and sheets of paper below. The cherubs appear in dynamic poses, with one holding a scroll, another offering laurel branches, and a few huddling near an anvil. The background shows swirling clouds, and there is French text inscribed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: The Garden Gate
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Natalie Fuller Allen and her children
artworks.description: The image depicts an outdoor scene with a partial structure. The perspective is set above and to the side, looking down at the scene. The horizon is not visible. The environment is portrayed using fine brushstrokes and cross-hatching, creating a textured look. The color palette is warm sepia tones. A figure wearing a wide-brimmed hat is sitting on the ground in a contemplative pose, partly hidden by shadows. A wooden gate is slightly open, leading into a leafy area that extends into the background filled with dense foliage.

artworks.title: The Virgin Swooning [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a human figure in a dramatic pose with arms raised upwards and head tilted back. The figure appears to be kneeling or sitting on its heels, enveloped in flowing drapery that accentuates the figure's form. The sculpture is portrayed in a drawing with shades of gray and brown, likely done in pencil or charcoal. The material of the sculpture is not specified. The sculpture is shown in a way that places it above eye level, emphasizing the raised arms and upward gaze.

artworks.title: Two Drapery Studies [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two separate studies of drapery and fabric. The upper half shows a finely shaded area of fabric with parallel lines indicating texture. The lower half features a detailed drawing of a bent arm, covered in a loose-fitting sleeve. The fabric is softly shaded to show creases and folds, giving a sense of three-dimensionality and weight. The drawing includes faded script and a number "20" in the central area.

artworks.title: Tower of the Cathedral at Sens
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brush and black ink, black chalk, and watercolor over graphite on brown paper
artworks.description: Two buildings nearly meet on either side of a more distant white cathedral tower in this loosely rendered watercolor drawing. The building to the right takes up two-thirds of the composition, and has a tall, pale brown roof, round-topped arches, and a section with gray engaged columns and pillars. The bottom zone is loosely sketched in with a few faint gray lines. Farthest from us, the white tower between the other two buildings has four levels of pointed arches. A spire extends from the right front corner of the tower, and the top edge of the entire structure is lined in spiky ornamentation. The third building, close to the left edge of the sheet, is a two-story wood structure with a tiled roof. The sky is painted ice blue in the narrow slivers between the buildings with some blank areas suggesting streaks of clouds. Cursive writing in graphite along the right edge of the paper reads, “Stairs and columns of Gothic arch Building.”

artworks.title: A Leaf from the Kelmscott Chaucer
artworks.medium: set in Chaucer and Troy types in black and red with decorative initials by William Morris, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of a beige textured book cover with a label and ties. The cover is light beige linen with two fabric ties on the right side. In the center, there is a rectangular label that reads "A Leaf from the KELMSCOTT CHAUCER. Together with a Monograph by Carl Purington Rollins." The text is black with selected phrases in red. The design highlights fine craftsmanship associated with book arts and the Kelmscott Press.

artworks.title: Trees by a Rail Fence
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. David Cleveland
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a large, gnarled tree, a winding path, houses in the distance, and a fence leading towards the tree. The sketch features detailed line work for texture and shading for depth, using a monochromatic color palette of gray and tan.

artworks.title: Mercury
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a sketch of a standing male figure. The person has a slightly bent posture, implying movement. The facial features are faint, and the figure appears muscular. The hair is loosely rendered. The figure is nude and holds a staff in one hand with minimal detail. The background has light shading but no specific environmental details. The artwork seems to be an early or rough pencil or charcoal sketch.

artworks.title: Skaters on the Serpentine in Hyde Park
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a winter scene with figures skating on a frozen river. Men in period attire are skating on the ice, with cottages and a leafless tree in the background. The sky is blue with white clouds, and the landscape extends into the distance. The painting features delicate brushwork with fine details and a color palette of blues, greens, and browns.

artworks.title: A Fête Galante with Falconers
artworks.medium: red chalk over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Neil and Ivan Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in elegant attire on a grassy area. One man gestures towards others while another operates a small theater. A small dog is nearby. In the background, there are rolling hills and sparse vegetation leading to a clear sky. The drawing is made using red chalk, giving it a soft, textured look with detailed strokes. The color palette is red and brown against a light tan background.

artworks.title: Going Out in the Morning
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching and aquatint on J. Whatman paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with figures and animals from an eye-level perspective. A large tree occupies the left side and top of the composition, potentially obscuring the horizon line. On the right, there are hounds playing. The figures are dressed in blue and red riding garments, riding horses with varied coats. The brushwork is illustrative with precise outlines, resembling an 18th-century print. The color palette is warm with browns, blues, and reds. In the distance, softer hues extend the landscape without defining a horizon.

artworks.title: The Chase
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching and aquatint on J. Whatman paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of mounted riders in a fast chase. One rider in a red coat has fallen off their horse, which is on the ground. Another rider in red is moving away from the viewer, heading down a slope. More riders in various colored coats, including blue, are galloping along a far ridge. The background consists of rolling hills going into the distance, with figures in pursuit. The sky is light blue with soft clouds. The brushwork shows movement and energy. The color palette includes warm browns and reds, as well as cooler blues, accentuating the drama of the chase.

artworks.title: The Death of the Fox
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching and aquatint on J. Whatman paper
artworks.description: The image shows a hunting scene where men on horseback are chasing a fox with hounds. One rider holds a horn up, and others in red and blue jackets are also in pursuit. The background has large, leafy trees that cover the sky, with bold brushstrokes and earthy tones throughout the painting.

artworks.title: The Dinner
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching and aquatint on (J. Whatman paper?)
artworks.description: This is a painting set in an opulent room where individuals in period attire stand around a large table holding glasses aloft as if toasting. The setting implies a celebratory gathering, with paintings and a suit of armor decorating the walls. The style of the painting is similar to Thomas Rowlandson, known for social scenes. Details such as elaborate furniture, a dog under the table, and scattered bottles contribute to the lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: Saint Paul Preaching
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 32.1 x 23.6 cm (12 5/8 x 9 5/16 in.)
overall (tipped into album page): 48.9 x 38.4 cm (19 1/4 x 15 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an ink drawing of a figure seen from the back, revealing the entire body from head to feet. The person stands with one foot slightly forward, appearing as if walking or stepping, and gestures with their right hand pointing upward and their left arm outstretched to the side. The facial features are not visible from this perspective, but the figure appears to have shoulder-length hair. The person is dressed in a flowing robe that drapes to the ankles, suggesting movement. Surrounding the figure at the lower right, there are several indistinct forms resembling heads or busts. In the background, there are sketchy outlines of architectural structures, like a roof or pavilion, rendered in a loose, impressionistic style.

artworks.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a figure in a flowing robe standing upright with arms outstretched and looking upward. The face has a calm expression, with wavy, medium-length hair. The loose robe drapes around the body with flowing folds. Several heads surround the figure, each facing different directions. The background has cloud-like formations with additional head figures and a foot among the clouds. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the figure's hands. The sketch style uses flowing lines and shading for depth and texture.

artworks.title: A Mastiff with a Gold-Tooled Collar
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and brown wash, with touches of gold ink, over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a small dog standing alert. The dog has a compact body, a short and curved tail, and prominent facial features including a defined snout and attentive eyes. Its fur is multi-colored with shades of black, brown, and white, and it has ears that hang down naturally. The dog is wearing a collar around its neck. The background is simple and unobtrusive.

artworks.title: Alexander Setting Fire to Persepolis
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite  on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an armored figure holding a sword amidst a scene of destruction. The figure is shown in a dynamic posture, surrounded by architectural ruins and a cloud of smoke or dust in the background. The style features sepia tones and intricate line work emphasizing the textures and details of the armor and cloak.

artworks.title: Mary Magdalene Praying in the Wilderness
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on vellum; laid down
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a kneeling figure in a forest setting. The figure is detailed, wearing flowing garments and surrounded by trees, a wooden cross, and a human skull. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and shading, depicting a landscape with mountains in the background under a clouded sky.

artworks.title: A Seated Man Holding a Tablet
artworks.medium: red chalk with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image depicts a male figure in a seated position, facing forward. The figure is drawn in a dynamic pose, with their torso turned slightly to the left. The person's head is tilted to the right, looking upwards. The face shows defined features such as cheekbones, a jawline, and a nose. The person has short to medium wavy hair. The figure appears muscular and is drawn nude. The right hand holds a large rectangular object, while the left arm extends outward with the hand pointing forward. There are no visible accessories or items being held. The background is a plain blue-gray textured surface, with the figure and objects outlined in a reddish-brown hue.

artworks.title: The Great Hercules
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 56.5 x 40.9 cm (22 1/4 x 16 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows a muscular man standing, his body facing us, with his legs in a wide stance and his head slightly turned to the left. He has pale skin, a short, curly beard, a thick, curled mustache, and long, curly hair partially obscured by the head and mane of a lion skin that he wears as a hood. He is holding a long, knotted club on his shoulder, and in his other hand he holds a curved, horn-like object. The man is nude except for the lion skin, which trails down his back like a cloak. The background features hilly terrain with rocks and small trees, and more people can be seen in the distance on the left and right, engaged in various activities, including a man wrestling a bull and three women sitting together. The sky has soft clouds. There are several lines of text below the print.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: black chalk on vellum
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait drawing of a man's upper body. The man is positioned in a three-quarter view, looking directly at the viewer with a composed expression. He has distinctive facial features including a wide forehead, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a pointed mustache, and a slightly curly beard. His medium-length, curly hair frames his face. He is dressed in a dark garment with a wide, white lace-trimmed collar, and there is a hanging piece of string or tassel on his clothing. The background is plain with a textured appearance suggesting the medium of pencil or charcoal.

artworks.title: Les Hirondelles (The Swallows)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river and flying swallows. The viewpoint is elevated. The sky has swirling clouds, and the landscape is detailed with etching lines. Swallows are flying close to the water. In the scene, there are lush grasses, shrubs, and trees along the river. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and dark sepia on a cream background.
